steps.title: Initialize Project Setup
steps.description: Configure app-meta.json, Tailwind CSS v4, and base HTML5 layout structures.

steps.title: Design Racing Arena UI & HUD
steps.description: Create responsive dashboard, garage, and heads-up display (HUD) overlay for the 3D race experience.

steps.title: Implement Three.js Scene & Lighting
steps.description: Set up Three.js perspective camera, dynamic lighting, shadows, and fog effects.

steps.title: Build Procedural Track & Environment
steps.description: Generate multi-lane highway, curbs, roadside obstacles, lamp posts, and neon skyline backdrops.

steps.title: Develop Player Car Model & Physics
steps.description: Construct low-poly modular sports car geometry, wheel steering angles, acceleration, and drift mechanics.

steps.title: Implement AI Opponents & Traffic Cars
steps.description: Program smart AI opponents with varying speeds and lane-changing behavior to challenge the player.

steps.title: Add Nitro Boost & Particle Systems
steps.description: Create high-speed motion blur, nitro flame exhaust particle effects, and screen shake.

steps.title: Implement Collision Detection & Damage
steps.description: Setup bounding box collision detection between player, traffic, and roadside barriers.

steps.title: Audio Sound Effects with Web Audio API
steps.description: Synthesize dynamic engine revving, tire screeching, nitro roar, and crash sound effects procedurally.

steps.title: Build Garage Car Customization & Upgrade Shop
steps.description: Allow players to upgrade top speed, acceleration, nitro boost, and car paint colors using earned race cash.

steps.title: Implement Backend Auth & Cloud Leaderboard
steps.description: Connect TrumpleDroid backend API for user authentication, cloud score syncing, and global high scores.

steps.title: Building streetnitro3dracing
steps.description: Finalize game loop, responsive resize handlers, performance optimizations, and polish UI transitions.
